verdict.rationale: Stripe's own tax docs claim to automate sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance on all transactions, which is a direct, first-party capability covering the tax types in the story. However, the evidence is a single thin line: it does not show tax being calculated on Billing invoices specifically, and it does not show how registrations or rates are managed. Missing for 10: documented per-invoice tax calculation in Billing, registration management, jurisdiction rate determination, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated on every invoice — natively or through a first-class tax integration — with the right registrations and rates

citations.quote: Automate sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance on all your transactions.
